exposure: Emergency transfer to tertiary NICUs on the first day of life
outcome: Respiratory care parameters (median expired tidal volume, mean airway pressure, minute ventilation, FiO2)
cohort: 55 extremely low birth weight (ELBW, <1000 g at birth) infants requiring emergency transfer to tertiary NICUs on the first day of life.
finding: Most ELBW infants transferred on the first day of life require mechanical ventilation and can be ventilated with 5 mL/kg tidal volume, with 55% surviving to NICU discharge.
